Exceptional veterinary clinic, thank you for saving my little rabbit Bianca when there was very little hope. Dr. Castelli took care of Bianca after she suffered from intestinal blockage for several days, followed by severe diarrhea, dehydration, and significant weight loss. After three days of hospitalization, I was able to bring Bianca home. Many thanks to the clinic staff who were so patient and kind despite my two or three calls a day. I highly recommend this clinic because it's very difficult to find veterinarians specializing in exotic pets.

A huge disappointment. Avoid this place!

I called ahead to let them know I would be 6 minutes late, and upon arrival, I apologized again for having a last-minute issue. (The veterinary assistant was excellent; thank you for her warm welcome and kindness). After my apology, the vet had the nerve to make a comment, saying, "We're already going, and you're late!" A complete lack of professionalism. She remained cold, gave my cat a cursory examination, told me that a procedure would need to be scheduled quickly, and asked me to go to reception to get a quote and an appointment. The quote, sent by email, was unexplained by the vet, with procedures priced double and treatments listed at the highest possible cost (€390). The blood test was done in some unknown location; they took my pet without explaining anything. To top it all off, the blood test results were slightly elevated because "my machine must have malfunctioned." At no point was I offered a repeat test to correct this error. A disgrace.

I have had cats for over 15 years and I have never had such a poor veterinary consultation, what a mistake to have wasted my time here.
Thank you very much for your rating and your trust. We are delighted that your visit went well. The entire team remains available to assist you with the follow-up and care of your pets.

We are very disappointed with the care we received. Our cat was diagnosed with FIP and his condition required urgent treatment. In total, we had to pay approximately €1,000 between the clinic and the emergency room, even though treatment was still ongoing.

Faced with this situation, we requested a refund of the amounts already paid so that we could arrange a payment plan for all the remaining treatments, solely to ensure our cat could continue receiving care. This option was not explained to us initially. Our request was refused, without any alternative being offered.

Today, we are left with a seriously ill cat and no financial means to continue his treatment. We understand that veterinary procedures have a cost, but we would have appreciated greater transparency from the outset regarding the payment terms and support in finding a solution appropriate to this emergency situation.

This isn't a review we're posting, but a huge thank you. For about ten years, Dr. Debette and his entire team were there for us every day with our little Patounette. Two very delicate operations for a rabbit, treatments that weren't always easy... but their advice and gentleness helped us give our Patounette the best life possible. If you're looking for a clinic with a personal touch, with people who work with heart, this is the place to go. Our rabbit had a dental problem, and every month, the same routine was followed so he could live a normal life. He lived 11 years with this dental issue because he received the best possible care. Appointments were easy to make. The diagnoses were effective, and the advice provided daily was delivered with all the affection we had, and will continue to have in a different way, with Bunny. Thank you to each and every one of you. For us, but also for him. I recommend them with all my heart. Titi, as you called him. Damien and Justine ❤️

One positive point and one negative point:
Positive: Pleasant and competent veterinarian.
Negative: Price rip-off. The same bag of kibble that I buy for €70 at a veterinary clinic costs €170 there. This isn't a difference in markup; it's a rip-off that, perhaps unfairly, shocks me and I find unethical.
The staff are attentive and caring.

Why are vets so expensive?
How do people manage on a small pension?
Love for animals isn't about lining your pockets.
